source_page: Gojek official white wordmark (Solv icon + 'gojek' wordmark), white variant for dark backgrounds
usage: Cover (slide 1) partner logo lockup on the Indonesia deck, co-branded top-right opposite the Navier wordmark.
notes: Official Gojek white wordmark. The sourced asset shipped with a baked dark (#191919) background masquerading as transparency; alpha was cleanly reconstructed via luminance-to-alpha (pure-white logo on uniform dark = unambiguous), then tightly trimmed to the 4.2:1 wordmark bounding box and verified crisp on the deck's navy. Use the white variant only on dark/navy; do not place on light backgrounds. This is the combined icon+wordmark master; do not substitute the standalone Solv icon.
